pro_course_detail.title: Experiencing Mandarin Chinese (55 mins)
pro_course_detail.description:
I offer 55 and 25-minute lessons.

If you are fascinated by Mandarin but have no or very little experience with the language, this series is for you. In this series, we will focus on the fundamentals while exploring the effect that Chinese culture has on the language.  

I teach the way that how human beings naturally acquire a language. While I make the lessons practical and tailored to your interest, learning this way warrants the most conversation competency and accurate pronunciation. 

I use a methodology that has been successfully applied to adults and children. Speaking briefly about this methodology - it includes a series of linguistic and body-centered learning techniques. I would patiently and skillfully guide you towards the feeling sense of the language and to use your visual and audio sensibilities to acquire the language. Grammar, analytical ability, and memorization are the secondary application.  I never cease to amaze how well my students thrive on this learning method. I would be happy to explain my teaching techniques and principles further in our first lesson/trial lesson. 

At the beginning of learning a language, it is critical to instill the foundation correctly. That means adopting a holistic approach to learn a language. In addition, Mandarin specifically, not only to pronounce correctly is important but also to learn from a skilled teacher who speaks with a neutral accent and a broadcast-quality of speaking voice is most favorable. 

For the course curriculum, you will learn--
1. The subjects of your interest.
2. Intonations
3. Simple greetings, expression of gratitude and regret.
4. Basic expressions and commands that are useful for traveling in Mandarin-speaking countries.
5. Personal introduction
6. Expressing emotions and preferences

pro_course_detail.title: ADVANCED LEVEL MANDARIN (C1-C2): SPEAKING LIKE A NATIVE!! Introduction to 成語 Chéngyǔ, the Four-character Chinese Idioms (55 mins)
pro_course_detail.description:
Teaching Example- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HRj1ss5miEU

I specifically design this 成語 Chéngyǔ course for individuals who want to speak like a native, such as the ability to exchange banters and express humor, deliver comments and criticism in Chinese sensibility and understand the popular media. 

If your Mandarin fits the following, you are ready for the course!!
1. A seasoned Advanced Mandarin (C1) speaker or higher
2. Knows about 1200 Chinese characters or more
3. Is capable of communicating your everyday needs, thoughts and desires in Mandarin
4. Is capable of grasping the main ideas when in communication with the natives

Chéngyǔ is a type of traditional Chinese idiomatic expression, most of which consists of four characters but not always. Sometimes they are referred to as four-character Idioms. They were widely used in Classical Chinese and play an important role in Chinese conversations and education. 

Using Chéngyǔ is a highly efficient way to communicate ideas. In the meantime, it incites rich imageries and literary fun. That is the genius of Chéngyǔ. They are windows to the world of the collective wisdom of Chinese culture. Some of them derive from historical references. Some of them contain moral concepts or cultural perspectives. Using Chéngyǔ in speech or writing is elegant yet colloquial.

Learning Chéngyǔ will increase the volume of your vocabulary and expand your cultural expressiveness to a whole new level. Consequently, your reading and listening abilities will also be vastly improved.

Learning Chéngyǔ is an enjoyable and holistic way to learn the language for both children and adults. I tell the story of each Chéngyǔ and use visual aids to illustrate the function of the Chéngyǔ in context to help you understand and easily retain what you learn. This is beyond textbook learning.  The in-class activities include listening and speaking exercises. The homework consists of writing and/or speech assignments utilizing the Chéngyǔ.
